notes.title: Working on the DWR Battle Path (Battle Pass) Menu
notes.content:
Greetings, Future Player!

Our indie team, Ars Magus, has a vision for our game that is gradually taking shape in DWR—one of the stories set in the tabletop universe of Divinate. Every tale brings new ideas and possibilities as it unfolds, and this inspired us to introduce a mechanic similar to the well-known Battle Pass, which we’ve named the Path of War.

Ars Magus has always been known for its honesty and straightforwardness—we don’t beat around the bush. As experienced gamers ourselves, we understand that a Battle Pass can’t just be filled with useless filler items (as is often the case) and expect players—the heart of the DWR community—to be happy with it.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45637631/1b1653fa000c23890213d415a8659281f62c233d.jpg[/img]
The Path of War features 60 levels and three stages:

The Exile Path – Available to all players, this path will inspire you to discover how the story of DWR’s Act I concludes, rewarding you with an exclusive character skin upon completion. This skin will only be obtainable during the current Path of War and cannot be acquired by any other means.

The Battle Path – Unlocked by default for Early Access owners. This path offers enhanced rewards, including an alternate character skin and an exclusive DWR Early Access account avatar. Like the Outcast’s rewards, these items will only be available during this Path of War and cannot be obtained later.

The Devotion Path – This stage will be accessible to crowdfunding backers via personal promo codes, available during fundraising campaigns aimed at hiring top-tier talent for Ars Magus Games. Crowdfunding allows us to remain independent developers, while you get to enjoy compelling stories that shape the Divinate universe.

In the end, this benefits everyone: DWR will thrive without constraints, and players will enjoy fresh design and dynamic gameplay.
